import bpy
from pathlib import Path

BASE_DIR = Path("/home/staz/pro/cs1")
OUTPUT_DIR = BASE_DIR / "output"

# 13 valid entries from bad-ones.txt (excluding the corrupted line)
BUILDINGS = [
    "120_degree_corner3x3",
    "comww4_1x4",
    "comww3_1x3",
    "Walmart",
    "condo_lowrise_24m6x4",
    "house_sf_narrow3_2x4d",
    "Kh_H3_2x2_LittonClothierBuilding",
    "KhH_TheHillcrest_L1_3x3",
    "KhH_TheHillcrest_L1_3x4",
    "lowrise_condo4x4",
    "mc-service-clinic01",
    "mc-station02",
    "skf-icecreamshop",
]

SPACING_X = 80.0

# Clear current scene objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="SELECT")
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

for i, name in enumerate(BUILDINGS):
    obj_path = OUTPUT_DIR / name / f"{name}.obj"
    if not obj_path.exists():
        print(f"[MISS] {obj_path}")
        continue

    print(f"[{i + 1}/{len(BUILDINGS)}] Importing {name}")

    before = set(bpy.context.scene.objects)

    # Blender 4.x first, fallback for older versions
    try:
        bpy.ops.wm.obj_import(filepath=str(obj_path))
    except Exception:
        bpy.ops.import_scene.obj(filepath=str(obj_path))

    after = set(bpy.context.scene.objects)
    imported = [o for o in (after - before) if o.type == "MESH"]

    x_off = i * SPACING_X
    for obj in imported:
        obj.location.x += x_off

print("Done.")
